inputs.original_text: Terry Pheto has once again been drawn into controversy, with new details presented in Parliament linking her to alleged financial misconduct involving the National Lotteries Commission. The revelations came during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. The report describes it as an alleged R20.56 million NLC funding scandal in an SIU probe.
